top_signals.title: The Diesel Crunch Isn’t Over Yet
top_signals.summary: Oil prices have tumbled by more than 20% so far in November with Brent Crude sinking below $90 per barrel this week, as market participants and analysts bet on continued recovery of crude oil flows from the Strait of Hormuz. The oil market balance appears to be tipping into oversupply, forecasters say, and crude prices are reflecting this notion. But the product markets, especially the diesel market, remain tight, despite recent declines in diesel margins and retail prices. Retail diesel prices in the United States last week fell below $6 per gallon…
